# 5. Analysis: Lambs

## 5.1 Survival is correlated with environmental variables

```{r}
#| label: lamb-models-calc
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Base model: main effects of snow, body mass, and density with sex interactions
lambs_survival_base <- brm(
  Survival ~ Sex * (avg_snow_depth + wtd114 + days_count + median_density + pop_den) + (1 | Yr), 
  data = Data_lamb_scaled, 
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),  
  cores = 4, chains = 4, warmup = 4000, iter = 10000, 
  threads = threading(2), backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 459300324
)
```

## 5.2 Survival is correlated with environmental variables in interaction with population density

```{r}
#| label: lamb-models-calc-dens
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Alternative model: snow effects modulated by population density
lambs_survival_pop <- brm(
  Survival ~ wtd114 + Sex * (avg_snow_depth + days_count + median_density) * pop_den + (1 | Yr), 
  data = Data_lamb_scaled, 
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),  
  cores = 4, chains = 4, warmup = 4000, iter = 10000, 
  threads = threading(2), backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 647133741
)
```

## 5.3 Selection & Results

```{r}
#| label: lamb-results
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Model comparison via LOO-CV
loo_lamb_base <- loo(lambs_survival_base)
loo_lamb_pop  <- loo(lambs_survival_pop)

loo_compare(loo_lamb_base, loo_lamb_pop)

# Posterior predictive check
pp_check(lambs_survival_base, ndraws = 100, type = "bars")

# Prior sensitivity analysis & probability of direction
lamb_power_analysis <- powerscale_sensitivity(lambs_survival_base)
p_direction(lambs_survival_base)

# Model summary and export to Word table
ft_lamb <- flextable(extract_brms_summary(lambs_survival_base, "Lamb")) |> autofit()
ft_lamb

doc <- read_docx()       
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft_lamb)   
print(doc, target = "result_model_lamb.docx")
```

## 5.4 Graphs

```{r}
#| label: lamb-plots
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# --- A. Conditional effect of average snow depth by sex ---
ce_snow <- conditional_effects(lambs_survival_base, effects = "avg_snow_depth:Sex", resp = "Survival")

plot_lamb_depth <- ce_snow$`avg_snow_depth:Sex` |>
  mutate(
    avg_snow_depth = avg_snow_depth * sd(Data_lambs_uns$avg_snow_depth, na.rm = TRUE) +
      mean(Data_lambs_uns$avg_snow_depth, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Calculate empirical mean survival rates for display
data_mean_lamb_depth <- Data_lambs_uns |>
  group_by(Sex, avg_snow_depth) |>
  summarise(
    survival_rate = mean(Survival, na.rm = TRUE), 
    n = n(),                                      
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lamb_depth <- ggplot(plot_lamb_depth, aes(x = avg_snow_depth, y = estimate__, color = Sex, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_point(
    data = data_mean_lamb_depth, 
    aes(x = avg_snow_depth, y = survival_rate, color = Sex, size = n), 
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, lineend = "round") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Female" = "#7a2554", "Male" = "#dd9a0a")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#7a2554", "Male" = "#dd9a0a")) +
  labs(
    x = "Average snow depth (cm)", 
    y = "Survival probability",
    color = "Sex",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

lamb_depth

# --- B. Conditional effect of snow cover duration ---
ce_days <- conditional_effects(lambs_survival_base, effects = "days_count", resp = "Survival")

plot_lamb_days <- ce_days$days_count |>
  mutate(
    days_count = days_count * sd(Data_lambs_uns$days_count, na.rm = TRUE) +
      mean(Data_lambs_uns$days_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

data_mean_lamb_days <- Data_lambs_uns |>
  group_by(days_count) |>
  summarise(
    survival_rate = mean(Survival, na.rm = TRUE), 
    n = n(),                                      
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lamb_days <- ggplot(plot_lamb_days, aes(x = days_count, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_point(
    data = data_mean_lamb_days, 
    aes(x = days_count, y = survival_rate, size = n), 
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), fill = "#4575b4", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(color = "#4575b4", linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  labs(x = "Snow cover duration (days)", y = "Survival probability") +
  theme_pubr()

lamb_days
```
